definitions.ask: Should repeated ⌃O keep walking back through older jumps, like Vim's jump list?
definitions.why: It matches Vim's ⌃O, which this keymap borrows.

choices.label: A second ⌃O after 2g-then-⌃O goes to an older jump, or says "No earlier page"
A second ⌃O returns to page 2, so repeated ⌃O flips between two pages

definitions.ask: Should each successful jump also flash a "Page N of M" alert?
definitions.why: Highlights' window title already shows the page, and Vim jumps are silent.

choices.label: Successful jumps stay silent; only out-of-range, empty-history, and failed jumps alert
Every successful jump also shows "Page N of M" briefly
